description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android project. It specifies a contract for implementing classes that handle logging, allowing chaining or filtering of log data.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging node that can output log data, potentially to multiple targets or filters.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with a specified priority, tag, message, and optional exception.
